messages:
alex.cheung: FYI — had a call with AtlasPay about tool-call ergonomics. They want structured tool results + deterministic fallback rules.

maria.gupta: tl;dr on asks?

alex.cheung: 3 bullets: 1) strict tool schema registry 2) result envelope with status + trace_id 3) runtime routing to fallback model/endpoint on schema mismatch or timeout

sam.walker: +1 on envelope. for MVP we should keep tool schemas optional but validate when present. avoid breaking existing clients

anya.kovalenko: Suggestion: enforce schema versions in header meta, like `tool_schema: bank-transfer:v1`. We need registry + migration rules.

jon.ramirez: Routing note: default policy = latency-first for hosted, cost-first for dev tier. Need policy config per route/customer. Also define SLA on tool-call latency and failure modes in product docs.

maria.gupta: Launch criteria proposal: docs + examples, registry UI, server-side validation, and e2e test harness.

alex.cheung: Customers want example of result envelope. Draft:
```json
{
  "status": "ok|error|timeout",
  "tool": "bank-transfer",
  "schema_version": "v1",
  "result": {...},
  "trace_id": "r-12345",
  "warnings": ["..." ]
}
```

sam.walker: Keep `result` opaque for now if unstructured. But include `validation_errors` when schema present.

anya.kovalenko: Registry design: immutable versions, linting step, opt-in schema enforcement per customer. We can reuse existing model versioning flow.

buildbot: [automated test] tool-schema-lint: bank-transfer:v1 -> FAIL: missing `amount.currency` field (see logs)

jon.ramirez: That's a good datapoint. We need lint rules for money formats, ISO codes, and timestamps.

maria.gupta: Prioritization tradeoff: full registry + UI = Q3 work, lightweight header + docs = Q2 MVP.

alex.cheung: OK proposed roadmap: Q2 MVP = envelope + header schema_version + opt-in validation + docs/examples. Q3 = schema registry + UI + enforcement policies + rollout flags.

sam.walker: Implementation notes: add `tool_call` module in runtime to attach trace, fallback hooks, and validation plugin.

anya.kovalenko: Security: schemas may expose PII fields. We need masking configs and KMS access controls for private deployments.

maria.gupta: Action items: alex to write RFC, eng-platform to estimate (sam + anya), legal/security to review PII guidance (jon to loop in), docs to draft sample prompts (maria)

alex.cheung: I'll spin up RFC by EOD Thursday. Tagging @sam.walker @anya.kovalenko @jon.ramirez

sam.walker: I'll take eng estimate, aim for spike next week.

jon.ramirez: Looping in security: @sec-team please weigh in on masking + audit logs.

maria.gupta: :thumbsup:
